proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5071 *chōṭṭa explicitly gives Hindi choṭā, Nepali choṭo and Kashmiri choṭ “short, small”. The selected small/short responses fit this lexical family, while the addendum distinguishes unaspirated *cōṭa and other child-name formations. Uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages does not prevent this supported family link under the user’s preference.
